q: The C¹-generic theory of diffeomorphisms (Pugh-Shub, Bonatti-Díaz-Viana): C¹-generically (for a residual set of diffeomorphisms in Diff¹(M)), every diffeomorphism satisfies:
opts: Periodic orbits are dense in the chain-recurrent set (Pugh's closing lemma for C¹ maps), and stable/unstable manifolds of periodic orbits are dense
exp: C¹ generic properties: (1) Pugh's closing lemma: recurrent orbits are approximated by periodic orbits (C¹-generically, periodic orbits are dense in the chain-recurrent set). (2) Kupka-Smale theorem: generically, all periodic orbits are hyperbolic and their stable/unstable manifolds intersect transversely.
